note: Real run on our own accounts, anonymised: brand, domain, pages, queries, competitors and ids replaced; numbers rounded to 2 significant figures, so totals may not add up exactly. Run on 2026-10-05 (account time zone) through the InsightfulPipe MCP; campaign and ad set names are replaced by their objective. This account has had almost no Meta spend, so the sample shows the skill's empty-account path rather than a full analysis.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "meta-ads-performance-analyzer" skill. Can you analyze my Meta Ads account for the last 28 days and tell me what's working, what's broken and what to do?

inputs_from_user.target_cost_per_result: not given; the default is the account's own cost per result over the current window, and there were no results
inputs_from_user.target_roas: not given; no ad set optimises for purchases
inputs_from_user.result_definition: default: each ad set's own optimisation event

get_ads (2 ads, to tie edits in the change history to their ad sets)
get_insights_adaccount call A, ad set level, current window with 1d_click / 7d_click / 1d_view (2 rows, spend 0.00)
get_insights_adaccount, campaign level, date_preset maximum: the empty-account lifetime call (2 rows)
